records.title: Visegrad Scholarship Programme — study or research stay hosted by Masaryk University
records.deadline_display: Masaryk University: "Annual deadline for applications: 15 March" | International Visegrad Fund: "Apr 15, 2027 at 12:00 PM: Final application deadline"

source.publisher: Masaryk University, Centre of Foreign Students (host institution)
source.notes: Two official sources give different values for the SAME deadline (final application deadline of the Visegrad Scholarship Programme), so per the brief this is CONFLICTING and no date may be written. (1) Masaryk University (host university page, the shard's official_source_url) states 'Annual deadline for applications: 15 March' with no year. (2) The International Visegrad Fund itself - the scholarship provider and therefore higher in the source hierarchy - states on its Visegrad Scholarship Program call page: 'Opens on Jan 1, 2027 at 12:00 PM', timeline 'Jan 1, 2027 at 12:00 PM: Call opens / Apr 15, 2027 at 12:00 PM: Final application deadline / May 31, 2027 at 12:00 PM: Results announced', and 'Your application must be submitted online via My Visegrad by April 15, 12 PM (noon)'. I did not attempt to decide which is correct and did not roll either value forward; 15 March vs 15 April is a disagreement about the same deadline, not two different programmes.

records.title: Heydar Aliyev International Education Grant (Study in Azerbaijan project)
records.deadline_display: Applications will be accepted for a period of 5 (five) years, beginning with the 2024–2025 academic year, with 100 educational grants awarded annually.

source.publisher: Ministry of Science and Education of the Republic of Azerbaijan
source.as_of: multi-year programme 'beginning with the 2024–2025 academic year'; page footer states 'Şəhifənin son yenilənmə tarixi: 28.01.2026' (last updated 28.01.2026)
source.raw_extract: By a decree of the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan dated July 8, 2023, an educational grant program was established to support the education of foreign citizens at higher education institutions in the Republic of Azerbaijan under the “Heydar Aliyev International Educational Grant” program. Applications will be accepted for a period of 5 (five) years, beginning with the 2024–2025 academic year, with 100 educational grants awarded annually.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Applications will be accepted for a period of 5 (five) years, beginning with the 2024–2025 academic year, with 100 educational grants awarded annually.
source.notes: No application deadline date is published in the HTML of either official page fetched. What the ministry states is the recurring annual award pattern ('100 educational grants awarded annually'), and the official Study in Azerbaijan portal states the grant 'will be offered annually for a period of 5 years'. That is recurring annual timing with no fixed current date, so semantics is ANNUAL and, per the brief, deadline_date stays null - no deadline was invented from the cycle pattern. The official portal page 'heydar-aliyev-international-education-grant-program' embeds only a call PDF, which was fetched but returned raw PDF binary with no extractable text through this toolchain, so no deadline was taken from it. Confidence is MEDIUM rather than HIGH because the per-call application window is only available in that PDF and could not be read.
